vb_textbox.text: It seems that the values with the colours changes throughout. Once you establish gnomes that are worth 0/1 mushrooms avoid that colour until it becomes obvious that there is a change.You seem to find out the change either by being unlucky and finding a different 0/1 gnome or by noticing some of the others have dropped. Good ones are between 6 and 9 mushrooms. Average ones seem to be between 3 and 6 and any 0/1/2 arn't great so avoid that colour for a bit.There are several colours that seem to appear together fairly regularly so once you work out which is worth more you know which one to pickl for a bit before a change.  Orange and yellow were together on mine loads, brown and blue, green and pink but i dont know for definite if yours will be the same as mine.Good luck and have fun!
